abstract: From the files of the Emil Novak Ovarian Tumor Registry, 18 cases of mixed ovarian germ-cell neoplasms containing endodermal sinus tumor as one element have been reviewed. The data regarding the patient age, presenting symptoms, gross appearance of the tumors, and response to therapy are similar to those reported in a previous series of pure endodermal sinus tumors. Response to all modes of therapy is disappointing but there is growing evidence that combination chemotherapy should be added to surgical excision as a routine part of therapy in such patients. The rarity of this lesion is such that meaningful data are likely to be available only if individual and institutional experiences are combined in central tumor registries.
abstract_ja: Emil Novak卵巣腫瘍登録の症例から、卵黄嚢腫瘍を一成分として含む卵巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍18例を検討した。患者年齢、症状、肉眼所見、治療反応は、以前報告された純粋な卵黄嚢腫瘍の系列と類似していた。いずれの治療法に対する反応も不満足なものであった。外科的切除に化学療法を日常的に加えるべきであるという証拠が増えつつある。この病変は稀であるため、有意義なデータは個々の施設の経験を集めた中央腫瘍登録によってのみ得られる可能性が高い。
